correctness.rationale: Under I_i=1, prefix record probability is 1/(j-1) for i<j (other j-1 prefix positions are exchangeable and their maximum necessarily exceeds i), 1/C(n-1,j-1) for i=j, and 1/j for i>j. Subtract P(I_i)P(R_j)=1/(nj) to obtain the triangular kernel. The j-1 earlier positions contribute 1/(nj), canceling the diagonal -1/(nj), leaving 1/[n*C(n-1,j-1)]. Summation and known fixed-point Var=1 and independent-record Var=H_n-H_n^(2) give the claimed correlation. Independently enumerated all permutations n=2 through 7 with Fraction exact arithmetic, checking every i,j covariance and total. Finite checks are supplementary to the all-n conditional counting proof.

value.rationale: The exact positional kernel disentangles the global fixed-point (cycle) and upper-record (order) statistics, identifies a nontrivial negative local-diagonal versus positive aggregate cancellation, and gives a quantitative finite-n and asymptotic dependence law. These are natural invariants of uniform permutations, not arbitrary refinements of a trivial count.

final_claim: Under a uniform permutation in S_n, for n>=2 and 2<=j<=n the exact covariance of fixed-point indicator I_i with left-to-right record R_j is 1/[n j(j-1)] for i<j, (1/n)(1/C(n-1,j-1)-1/j) for i=j, and zero for i>j; the total fixed/record covariance is (1/n) sum_{k=1}^{n-1} 1/C(n-1,k) and correlation is asymptotic to 1/(n sqrt(log n)).
limitations: Only the uniform S_n distribution and upper records are covered; no claimed independence or general law for conjugation-invariant or biased measures.
